title: Software Engineer II, Technical Search Visibility
description:
We're transforming the grocery industry

At Instacart , we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.

Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.

Instacart is a Flex First team

There’s no one-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work-whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop-while staying connected and building community through regular in-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

Overview
The Marketing Enablement & Technology (MET) team sits within Instacart 's Marketing organization, building the systems, data pipelines, and platforms powering Instacart 's growth. Operating at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Engineering, we own the platforms behind campaign feeds, audience targeting, event pipelines, and QA automation.
We're seeking a Software Engineer II for the Technical Search Visibility pod to build features and systems that enhance Instacart 's search engine visibility and drive organic traffic - one of our most substantial growth levers. You'll develop full-stack features that improve SEO performance across millions of web pages, contribute to data pipelines that surface optimization insights, and work across our stack to ensure our platform is discoverable by millions of users. You'll deliver features end-to-end, contribute to technical decisions, and partner closely with Marketing and Product to translate growth requirements into scalable solutions.
About the Job

• Build and ship full SEO and AEO features end-to-end with minimal oversight, from development through experimentation and rollout.

• Design, build, and ship high-quality full-stack features that enhance search engine visibility, AI answer engine performance, and organic traffic with a strong sense of urgency and ownership.

• Apply technical best practices to deliver performant, observable, and cost-aware code that improves traditional search rankings, LLM visibility, and user experience.

• Contribute to data pipelines for SEO and AEO data ingestion, transformation, and delivery, applying simple, reusable abstractions to keep the system healthy as it grows.

• Collaborate with product managers, designers, and marketing partners to translate user needs into technical requirements, surface trade-offs, and deliver on shared goals.

About You
Minimum Qualifications

• 2-4 years of software engineering experience with proficiency in React, Ruby, Python, PostgreSQL, and SQL.

• Demonstrated ability to build and launch complete features end-to-end with minimal oversight, including development, experimentation, and production rollout.

• Experience with distributed systems and data engineering - designing pipelines, optimizing schemas, and ensuring data quality - with exposure to Airflow or DBT.

• Ability to write performant code and improve system observability through logging and metrics, identifying and resolving bottlenecks as they arise.

• Strong product mindset with the ability to translate user needs into technical requirements and understand how your work impacts business metrics.

• Effective communicator who can collaborate across marketing, product, and engineering partners to align on requirements and deliver solutions.

title: Principal Backend Development Engineer(Risk)
description:
About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 - connecting users to the future of digital finance.

 

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

 

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Key Responsibilities

 

• Develop and maintain core market data modules

• Design and optimize real-time market data computation and low-latency push pipelines

• Tune system performance under high-concurrency, high-throughput scenarios to ensure accuracy and timeliness of market data

• Participate in technical design reviews and code reviews

• Build system observability infrastructure, including monitoring & alerting, distributed tracing, and logging systems

• Participate in production incident investigation and post-mortem reviews

 

Requirements

 

• 3+ years of Go development experience; solid understanding of Go's concurrency model, memory model, and GC mechanics

• Experience designing high-concurrency, low-latency systems; familiar with common performance bottlenecks and optimization techniques

• Familiar with message queues (Kafka / Redis Streams, etc.) in data streaming architectures

• Proficient with real-time data transport protocols such as WebSocket and gRPC

• Strong engineering discipline - clean code structure and a habit of conducting code reviews

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment.

- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.

title: Talent Acquisition Specialist - Canada
description:

We are looking for a relentless Talent Acquisition Specialist to build the future of our team. We don’t hire through standard job boards alone; we find the outliers, the grinders, and the Web3 natives who are hidden in the corners of the internet. Must be based in Canada , you will be responsible for the full recruitment lifecycle, from aggressive headhunting to final onboarding, ensuring we only hire the top 1% of talent.

• Active Headhunting: Don’t wait for applicants. Proactively source candidates on LinkedIn, Twitter, Discord, and GitHub to find "whispering talent" for marketing, operations, and legal roles.

• Vetting & Screening: Conduct rigorous initial interviews to filter for "the eye," technical Web3 literacy, and cultural fit.

• High Autonomy: You will be working remotely and managing your own desk. You must be organized, results-driven, and capable of hitting hiring targets without hand-holding.

• Location: Remote (Must be based in Canada).

• Schedule: Full-time (High flexibility required to coordinate interviews across multiple time zones).

Why Join Us?

• Shape the Organization: You aren't just filling seats; you are hand-picking the people who will define this company's success.

description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Enforcement Lead, you will be responsible for managing and executing enforcement actions across our products and services, with a focus on detecting and mitigating attempts to misuse Anthropic's AI systems for malicious cyber operations. Your work will center on developing strategic enforcement frameworks for flagged activity related to cyberattacks, malware development, and offensive exploitation. Additionally, you will manage a team of Cyber Enforcement Analysts and contractors implementing this enforcement strategy. 

Safety is core to our mission, and you'll help uphold policy enforcement so that our users can safely interact with and build on top of our products in a harmless, helpful, and honest way.

Manage a team of Cyber Enforcement Analysts and contractors, overseeing the vision of Cyber Enforcement strategy

Create strategies to detect and mitigate potential misuse of AI systems to facilitate cyberattacks, malware creation, exploitation tooling, and related harmful cyber operations

Collaborate with stakeholders regarding novel, ambiguous, or high-severity cases

•
Collaborate with the Safeguards Policy Design Team on policy gaps surfaced through real enforcement scenarios

•

•
Keep up to date with emerging AI policy enforcement best practices, threat actor tactics, and the evolving cyber threat landscape, using these to inform enforcement decisions

Experience as a people manager

•
Experience in cybersecurity, including knowledge of offensive techniques, exploit development, malware analysis, or vulnerability research

•
Experience performing content review, abuse investigations, or policy enforcement at volume

•
Proficiency in SQL and/or Python for data analysis and threat detection

•
Experience identifying emerging risks and communicating findings to a diverse set of stakeholders, such as Product, Policy, Engineering, and Legal teams

•
Experience working with generative AI products, including writing effective prompts for content review and enforcement

Preferred qualifications

•
Experience in trust & safety, abuse investigations, cybersecurity investigations, or threat intelligence in a technology or AI company

•
Experience with large language models and an understanding of how AI technology could be misused for cyber operations

•
Experience operating within abuse monitoring programs or enforcement review systems

•
Understanding of the challenges involved in implementing product policies at scale, including in the content moderation space

•
Experience working with government agencies, regulated environments, or information sharing communities

title: FP&A Analyst
description:
About Influur

Influur is reimagining how advertising works - through creators, data, and AI. Our mission is to make influencer marketing as measurable, predictable, and scalable as paid media - and we're building the tech that makes it possible. Backed by top-tier investors and trusted by global brands, we're scaling fast across music, culture, and entertainment.

We're looking for an FP&A Analyst who's excited to build real financial modeling skills inside a fast-growing, AI-native finance team.

The Role

You'll work directly with the FP&A Lead, supporting budget tracking, financial modeling, and forecasting across Influur 's business lines. This is not a data-entry role - it's a seat where you'll learn real FP&A from the ground up: how to build models the right way, how to read what the numbers are actually saying, and how to turn that into decisions leadership can act on.

We're looking for someone who already has real modeling fundamentals - we're not here to teach the basics of a formula or what a balance sheet is. What we will teach is how to apply that foundation to budgeting, contingency planning, rebudget cycles, and investor-grade reporting. If you have the base and the hunger to grow into it, this is your seat.

Your Skillset:

Must-haves:

• 1-2 years of experience in FP&A, investment banking, financial consulting, or a closely related analytical role

• Real, demonstrable financial modeling fundamentals - you know how to build a model from scratch, with clean structure and documented assumptions, not just fill in a template

• Advanced (Intermediate) Excel / Google Sheets - formulas, structuring data, comfortable without a template

• Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, and how the three financial statements connect

• Strong attention to detail - you catch inconsistencies in data before they become errors

• English proficiency, B2 or above (written, spoken, and reading)

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or related field
Nice-to-haves:

• Exposure to multi-business-unit or multi-entity P&L environments

• Curiosity about AI tools applied to finance - you don't need to be an expert, but you're already experimenting

• Experience supporting investor reporting or board-level materials

• Startup or high-growth company experience

You're the Type Who:

• Has real modeling bases, but doesn't pretend to know everything - you want to be trained, and you're hungry to learn

• Takes ownership without being asked twice

• Is genuinely curious about AI - you already use it, even if you're not an expert, and you want to get better

• Pays obsessive attention to detail - a wrong formula or a mislabeled row bothers you until it's fixed

• Is comfortable with ambiguity - startups don't hand you a finished playbook

• Has a startup mindset: speed, resourcefulness, and comfort wearing more than one hat

First 90 days:

• Fully ramped on Influur 's financial structure, reporting cadence, and modeling standards

• Owns the monthly budget-vs-actuals tracking process independently

• Has contributed to at least one full rebudget cycle

• Shows growing fluency applying AI tools to real reporting and modeling workflows

What we offer:

• Remote work

• Direct mentorship from the FP&A Lead and CFO, with a clear growth path

• Real ownership from day one - your models inform board and investor decisions

• Opportunity to build modern, AI-assisted FP&A skills inside a real finance function

• A collaborative, high-ownership team environmen

description:
Supporting Cast seeks a passionate, creative developer with PHP and agentic engineering experience to expand onSupporting Cast’s podcast subscription platform. As a key member of our team, you'll be helping independent creators, podcast publishers, and media companies improve their financial sustainability and better satisfy their fans. You'll be joining a small development team and will be in a position to influence our tech stack and our evolving product. Working here provides the dynamic excitement of a startup, and the stability and competitive compensation of an established employer.

We will consider candidates from anywhere in the United States, provided you can largely work East Coast hours-the role is fully remote.

About the Position

Opportunities:

• Learn a lot about the podcast industry and the rapidly growing paid subscription market

• Scale an application as we onboard clients with tens of thousands of members and evaluate new technologies

• Develop and maintain user- and administrator-facing features in our existing stack

• Help us leverage A.I. tools to accelerate new feature development and improve code quality and security

• Build and maintain implementations for other websites, including embeds and third-party integrations

Our Current Tech Stack:

•
App : PHP/Laravel, Nginx, Varnish, Redis, PostgreSQL, Docker, React

•
Dev ops : AWS, Fastly CDN

•
Key business vendors and partners: Stripe, Spotify, Wordpress

•
Key software vendors: Google Cloud Computing, AWS (SES/SNS/SMS), Anthropic

•
Repo: GitHub

•
Project management: Agile-oriented. Notion, Google Docs, Slack.

Requirements

• 1-3 years of professional experience with PHP and a PHP framework such as Laravel

• 1-2 years of experience with LLM-based A.I.

• Familiarity with programming fundamentals and industry best practices; a CS degree is a plus but not required

• Willingness to adapt and learn on the job

WHY JOIN SUPPORTING CAST?
You’ll help make workplaces more connected, informed, and interesting via the magic of podcasting. Supporting Cast built one of podcasting’s first and most successful subscription management platforms for top public podcasters before expanding to improve employee experiences at some of the most interesting companies in the world.
You’ll be the first hire for this function. This is a great opportunity if you want ownership of your work, a taste of startup life, and the responsibility of setting the bar high for a new team. You’ll also enjoy competitive salary and benefits in a remote-first, mission-driven, and family-friendly team.
About Supporting Cast:
Supporting Cast is a podcast monetization platform that helps top publishers and creators offer premium subscription content directly to listeners. Our clients include leading podcast publishers like NPR, SiriusXM, and NBC, along with major independent shows. A proponent of the open ecosystem, we make it seamless for subscribers to access premium podcast content in their favorite app-no new app to download-and give publishers the tools to grow and manage their paying audience with flexible integrations, analytics, and payments.
We’re a small, fully remote company with a strong belief in the future of audio. We’re looking for someone who is thoughtful and detail-oriented to help us bring the magic of podcasting into more corporate settings.
Supporting Cast is an affiliate of the Graham Holdings Company (NYSE:GHC). GHC is a diversified holding company whose operations include educational services; home health and hospice care; television broadcasting, online, print, and local TV news; automotive dealerships; manufacturing; hospitality; and consumer internet companies.

Je krijgt de ruimte om te groeien, nieuwe ideeën te testen en te experimenteren, met volop aandacht voor de nieuwste AI-ontwikkelingen. Dit alles binnen een gestructureerd traject van 2 jaar.

title: Senior Solutions Consultant
description:
Apollo .io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo .io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo .io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

At Apollo , Senior Solutions Consultants don't just support deals, they shape them. This role sits at the intersection of revenue, product, and the customer, directly influencing how Apollo wins, retains, and expands its most strategic accounts. As a trusted technical and strategic advisor across the full customer lifecycle, this person drives complex, high-stakes deals forward, accelerates time-to-value, and influences long-term business outcomes for our customers. This person is not only an expert in solution architecture, but they also serve as player-coach who scales the impact of the SC function through mentorship, strategic influence, and repeatable playbooks and tools.
You will partner with AEs and AMs, Sales Leadership, Customer Success, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to architect end-to-end solutions, from discovery through customer onboarding and expansion. You will also help scale the Solution Consulting team by building repeatable playbooks and tools, documenting best practices, and mentoring peers.
What You’ll Do

•
Discovery & Value Selling - Lead technical and business discovery to uncover pain, success metrics, and buying criteria. •

•
POC & Trial Execution - Design and run POC-based trials that validate business impact early, identify leading indicator success metrics, and accelerate decision-making. Facilitate the pre-sale to post-sale handoff to ensure smooth onboarding and expansion readiness for our customers.

•

Leverage REST APIs, CRM/marketing automation, and tools like Zapier or Workato to integrate Apollo into the GTM stack, decreasing customer time-to-value and long-term scalability.

•
Product Strategy - Serve as the voice of the customer, advising on go-to-market solution optimization and surfacing actionable feedback from the field to influence product roadmap priorities, GTM strategy, and how Apollo wins and retains customers.

•
Full-funnel Solution Management & Tooling - Co-create solutions that drive adoption, manage process change, and work closely with Onboarding and Success teams to mitigate post-sale risk and ensure customers achieve measurable value.

•
Mentorship & Enablement - Coach peers on discovery, demos, and technical and solution strategy - while contributing to internal enablement sessions, building playbooks, demo environments, and competitive resources that elevate team performanc

title: Senior Creative Strategist
description:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes  and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come - and return - to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. You'll partner closely with the wider finance function and cross-functional teams across the business, helping make finance a great partner to the rest of the company. The day-to-day processes are yours to run and improve: where something is manual or unclear, you'll have the real opportunity to make it better. - Oversee client invoicing and manage billing workflows.

- Assist with month-end close procedures, bank reconciliations, and general ledger maintenance.

- Proficiency in spreadsheet software and financial tools. An understanding of AI-native finance stacks would be advantageous

- Proactive mindset with the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, growing environment.

title: Lead CPA - Bill Pay & Tax Practice
description:
We're looking for a CPA who wants to build something - not from scratch, and not alone, but with the freedom to shape a practice the way it should be shaped.
Our firm provides integrated financial care to physician families across California and several other U.S. states. We currently serve hundreds of households, and we're adding to the ways we serve them.
Today, our clients' tax and bookkeeping needs are served through external partner firms we've worked with for years. That partnership has helped us get to where we are, and it will continue. At the same time, we see meaningful gaps we'd like to fill ourselves - starting with bill pay and straightforward tax preparation. We'd like you to lead that work.
WHAT YOU'D BE BUILDING
A premium, integrated practice that complements the financial planning our clients already receive from us. You'd start with a built-in client base, an established brand, and something most CPAs building a practice never get: a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support. That means your time goes to the craft and the client conversations, not to sales, marketing, recruiting, legal, nor IT.
The practice is designed to evolve with our clients' needs over time, and you'll have a meaningful voice in how it grows.
WHAT YOU'D DO

• Provide bill pay services for elders and high-net-worth client families

• Prepare straightforward personal tax returns, primarily for W-2 households

• Shape how the practice grows, including how we manage the natural seasonality of tax work

• Collaborate with other team leaders to design repeatable systems that fit within our existing framework. Fitting in with our processes is essential.

YOU'LL ALSO BRING YOUR EXPERTISE TO

• Helping clients keep their financial records organized and decision-ready

• Guiding clients through entity-related questions that come up in their financial lives

• Bringing a tax-informed perspective into our team's planning conversations

• Being a trusted, knowledgeable resource for clients on the financial details that matter to them

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Licensed CPA in good standing

• Meaningful experience in tax preparation, with some exposure to bookkeeping

• Drawn to the idea of designing a practice rather than inheriting one

• A clear, warm communicator who genuinely enjoys client relationships

• Comfortable working remotely and collaborating across time zones

• Interested in the physician niche, or excited to learn it deeply

HOW WE WORK
We've been a fully distributed company since 2013, and over the years we've built a global team of seasoned client service associates who handle first contact and administrative support for every advisor, including you. Our shared priority is to protect your time for online conversations with clients.
Compensation is negotiable and tailored to the right person. We're open to W-2 with bonus or 1099, depending on what fits your situation and goals.

title: Emulation Engineer, Automotive Robotics
description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

Tenstorrent is seeking a high impact Emulation Engineer to help bring our SiP based AI or ML engines to life through scalable, high performance emulation platforms. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on technical ownership, solves system level problems, and wants to influence silicon debug, DV, and performance from the ground up. You will build the infrastructure that allows our chiplet based systems to be explored, tested, and validated across hardware, software, and architectural layers.

Who You Are

• Bring 10+ years of SoC or ASIC experience, including a deep understanding of logic design, verification, and emulation platforms.

• Fluent in Verilog or SystemVerilog, C or C++, and SystemC, with hands-on experience using commercial emulators such as ZeBu, Palladium, or Veloce.

• Confident in architecting DV and emulation environments, from transactors to monitors to debug hooks, and automate everything you can.

• Collaborative and self driven, with a passion for mentoring junior engineers and working cross functionally with architecture, software, and DV teams.

What We Need

• A passion to build and scale a multi chiplet emulation ecosystem that supports DV, software development, and power or performance debug.

• Comfort in developing testbenches, transactors, monitors, and support systems to enable high quality, high efficiency emulation usage.

• Experience in driving emulation coverage from functional and performance to low level software enablement, and automate as much of the flow as possible.

• To optimize the platform for frequency, resource sharing, and end user support, ensuring Tenstorrent teams get the most from emulation.

What You Will Learn

• Building an emulation flow that supports chiplet based SiPs at scale, spanning AI workloads, interconnects, and system level power.

• How Tenstorrent integrates AI engines, RISC V CPUs, die to die links, PCIe, UCIe, and memory controllers into one unified platform.

• To align virtual prototyping, power analysis, and emulation into a full stack validation solution.

• How emulation sits at the core of a cross functional silicon bring up strategy, from RTL to post silicon debug and customer delivery.

title: Freelancer: Projektmanager (m/w/d)
description:
[Bulle & Mensch] ist der deutschsprachige Video-Podcast über das echte Handwerk erfolgreicher Trader und Investoren: Setup, Psyche und der Mensch hinter den Entscheidungen.
Signale, Hypes und Lambo-Versprechen gibt es woanders. Bei uns sprechen Trading-Weltmeister, professionelle Investoren und Menschen mit außergewöhnlichen Erfolgsgeschichten offen über Strategien, Fehler, Rückschläge und das, was langfristig wirklich funktioniert.
Unser Ziel ist klar: Bis Ende 2027 wollen wir die reichweitenstärkste deutschsprachige Fin-Podcast-Marke werden - mit YouTube als Hauptplattform. Dafür wächst unser Team, und die Prozesse dahinter brauchen jemanden, der sie zusammenhält, vorantreibt und weiterdenkt.
Aufgaben
Als Projektmanager:in (m/w/d) bist du die zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mario und allen laufenden Prozessen rund um [Bulle & Mensch]. Du sorgst dafür, dass Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften ineinandergreifen, Deadlines eingehalten werden und nichts liegen bleibt.
Dabei bist du nicht nur Prozesshüter:in, sondern Treiber:in: Du behältst den Überblick über das Gesamtprojekt, erkennst, wo es hakt, und schiebst Themen aktiv an - auch wenn sie noch niemand explizit an dich delegiert hat. Genauso wichtig ist der zweite Teil der Rolle: Du identifizierst neue Projekte und Wachstumschancen für [Bulle & Mensch], bringst sie strukturiert auf die Schiene und begleitest sie von der Idee bis zur Umsetzung.
Du arbeitest eng mit Mario und den Freelancer:innen im Team zusammen, führst Fäden zusammen, die sonst lose blieben, und sorgst mit klaren Strukturen dafür, dass gute Ideen nicht in internen Abstimmungsschleifen untergehen.
Deine Aufgaben

• Laufende Prozesse rund um Redaktion, Booking, Produktion, Social Media und Partnerschaften koordinieren und weiterentwickeln

• Deadlines, Verantwortlichkeiten und offene Punkte im Blick behalten und proaktiv nachfassen

• Bestehende Abläufe (u. a. in Notion) dokumentieren, vereinfachen und für das Team verständlich halten

• Freelancer:innen und Teammitglieder koordinieren, Aufgaben verteilen und Fortschritt nachhalten

• Engpässe, Doppelarbeit und blinde Flecken im Projekt frühzeitig erkennen und lösen

• Neue Projektideen (Formate, Kooperationen, Kanäle, Tools) identifizieren, bewerten und strukturiert aufsetzen

• Neue Projekte von der ersten Idee über die Planung bis zur Umsetzung begleiten und dabei die Verantwortung behalten, bis sie laufen

• Regelmäßig mit Mario den Gesamtstatus des Projekts abstimmen und Prioritäten vorschlagen

Qualifikation

• Erfahrung im Projekt- oder Prozessmanagement, idealerweise im Medien-, Content- oder Startup-Umfeld

• Fähigkeit, aus vielen losen Enden eine klare Struktur mit Prioritäten und Deadlines zu machen

• Eigenständige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise - du musst nicht angeschoben werden, du schiebst selbst an

• Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift, sicheres Sprachgefühl in der Kommunikation mit Team und Partnern

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Tools wie KI Agenten oder Notion

• Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Personen und Aufgaben zusammenzuführen

• Offenheit für direktes Feedback sowie die Fähigkeit, Entscheidungen klar zu begründen

Benefits
Du übernimmst nicht nur Verwaltung - du hältst das Projekt zusammen und treibst sein Wachstum aktiv mit.

•
Echte Verantwortung: Du bekommst nicht nur Aufgaben zugewiesen, sondern gestaltest mit, wie das Projekt organisiert wird und wohin es sich entwickelt.

•
Klares, ambitioniertes Ziel: Reichweite ist bis Ende 2027 die zentrale Priorität. Gute Ideen verschwinden bei uns nicht hinter internen Abstimmungsschleifen.

•
Außergewöhnliches Ausgangsmaterial: Lange, ungeschönte Gespräche mit erfolgreichen Tradern, Investoren, Unternehmern und Finanzpersönlichkeiten liefern Substanz statt austauschbarer Content-Häppchen.

Eigene KI-Innovation: Mit Frag [Bulle & Mensch] haben wir einen eigenen KI-Podcast-Assistenten entwickelt.

title: AI Researcher
description:
About FirstPrinciples : FirstPrinciples is a non-profit organization building an autonomous AI Physicist to understand the nature of reality: the underlying structure, governing principles, and fundamental laws of our universe. We're developing an intelligent system that can explore theoretical frameworks, reason across disciplines, and generate novel insights to tackle the deepest unsolved problems in physics. By combining AI, symbolic reasoning, and autonomous research capabilities, we're developing a platform that goes beyond analyzing existing knowledge to actively contribute to physics research. Our goal is to accelerate progress on the questions that have captivated humanity for centuries.
We operate as a global nonprofit organization , with a Canadian foundation, a US-based 501(c)(3).
Job Description:We are looking for a Member of Technical Staff, Research to investigate, design, test and develop state of the art (SOTA) methods and applications, which can be integrated into the broader AI engine FirstPrinciples is developing. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams and your work will flow straight into production, helping advance the way scientific research is performed. Your work will impact the wider academic community through the development of unique solutions to usher in a new era of scientific discovery. The ideal candidate has a proven track record in AI research, who can combine strategic thinking with technical depth to bring complex ideas to life.
Key Responsibilities:
Fundamental Model Research:

• Research, design, and test novel, research‑specific model architectures that integrate academic literature, natural language processing (NLP), symbolic reasoning, and other methods to orchestrate the scientific process.

• Prototype and build custom tokenizers for LaTeX symbols and physical units to be treated as tokens.

• Explore alternatives to transformers through in-depth research and provide practical recommendations for model development.

• Develop reinforcement-learning loops to enable models to run independent and internal thought experiments.

Multimodal Data & Benchmarking:

• Design and automate data ingestion pipelines in collaboration with our Data Scientists & Engineers that aggregates science literature, metadata, experimental data, equations and other data sources in a robust and scalable manner.

• Establish custom benchmarks to assess the models’ understanding of physical concepts, mathematical reasoning abilities, and ability to minimize hallucinations for the benefit of scientific reliability.

• Refine and release datasets and baselines once internal tests are stable.

Training, Testing & Safety:

• Run and track model training jobs while leading the technical team through set-up, monitoring progress, and constraining costs within budget.

• Develop approaches to stage “practice runs” in a sandbox environment to develop the model’s abilities to explore ideas independently while logging results for later review.

• Develop a framework to evaluate the models’ learning using visual and statistical tools to spot patterns and blind spots.

• Add guard-rails and tests that flag poor quality model output.

• Maintain internal tools to track lists of known issues, noting failures, clear fixes, and improvements to be integrated into future development

Collaboration & Technical Guidance:

• Work with the engineering team to ensure product feasibility and robust architecture.

• Translate technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders in clear terms.

• Present findings in clear updates to the technical team in order to keep the broader team appraised of progress against research milestones.

Qualifications:

• Educational Background : PhD in physics, computer science, data science, information systems, or related field.

• Experience : Proven track record of conducting in-depth research on scientific AI models, symbolic models, machine learning or deep learning for scientific discovery.

Watershed is seeking an experienced Accounting Manager to own our global general ledger accounting, financial close, and audit preparation as we scale. This role will be responsible for accurate financial reporting, strong internal controls, and full audit cycle execution. You'll also directly manage and mentor accounting team members as our accounting team grows.

This is a US GAAP-based role supporting our global, consolidated reporting; knowledge of Mexican statutory/monthly reporting requirements or UK GAAP is a plus, not a requirement.

As Accounting Manager, you'll be the engine behind our financial close process and the point person for audit execution and statutory compliance across all Watershed entities and geographies. GL Management & Financial Close

- Manage the global general ledger, chart of accounts, and intercompany accounting.

- Drive the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process end-to-end across all Watershed entities and geographies, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.

- Own a portfolio of accounts through close, reconciliations, and journal entries.

- Prepare and own US GAAP financial statements, including building the cash flow statements from the ground up.

- Perform flux analysis, explaining period-over-period movements across the balance sheet and income statement.

- Own investor and board-level financial reporting.

- Architect our group-level intercompany framework, elimination logic, transaction-flow documentation, and sources of truth, designed to absorb new entities and future acquisitions.

- Streamline our intercompany cost-sharing arrangements (pay-on-behalf-of / collect-on-behalf-of) and redesign and automate the cost-allocation process.

Audit, Technical Accounting & Compliance

- Serve as primary point person for external audits, preparing comprehensive documentation (PBC lists, workpapers, flowcharts, walkthroughs) and coordinating all audit activities, ensuring deliverables are consistently audit-ready with clear supporting evidence.

- Apply technical US GAAP guidance in key areas including allocations, cashflow, carbon credit accounting, COGS, fixed-assets, FX, lease accounting, and stock-based compensation.

- Take ownership of tax compliance across multiple jurisdictions and coordinate with external advisors.

title: Senior 3d Artist
Have a civic idea? (earlier stage)
description:
The Context
Our work is grounded in the idea that some of our hardest challenges - posed by increasing inequality and climate change - are some of our biggest collective opportunities to innovate.
As a civic incubator, Edge partners with public, private, and nonprofit organizations to tackle systemic economic challenges in Stockton. With a focus on three key areas - jobs and workforce, climate, and community wealth - Edge seeds and supports partner-led initiatives with a range of tools. These tools include access to capital, talent, policy support, and coalition-building.
As we identify those 'edge' challenges, we partner with organizations to design creative, non-traditional solutions to them - and incubate them (anywhere from several months to several years ), until the point at which they're ready to be 'spun out' to live on their own. By virtue of the way that we work, we are always interested in learning how others think about these things.
The Engagement
Don't see a role that's a good fit for you, but intrigued by our work as a civic incubator? We'd love to hear from you. While we have a small and mighty team that is focused on incubating existing initiatives (in Stockton, CA), we're open to meeting individuals across the US who are in pursuit of tackling civic challenges. For individuals who want to share their emerging interests and learn from the way that Edge Collaborative does civic incubation, please apply with a proposal.
If you have a pressing civic challenge or idea to share, we'd love to hear from you. Please feel free to outline the answers to these questions in your proposal, in addition to whatever else you'd like to share with the Edge Collaborative team.
Part A
1. What civic challenges do you believe are being ignored? Why are these critical to address now?
2. What idea (earlier stage) or concept (later stage) would you like to work on? What compelled you to think that it needs to be further explored and better understood? What initially inspired you?
3. Are you proposing to affiliate with Edge Collaborative for a shorter or longer period of time? Do you have a sense of what type of support you might require from the Edge team? Examples: intellectual sounding board, access to community relationships, technical assistance, fundraising support, etc. Are you interested in a volunteer position, or a paid one?
Team Values
Beginner’s mindset - we love asking the ‘stupid questions’ to understand what is possible. Our greatest asset is our curiosity as beginners (not experts). We want to discover how and why particular systems and people have been historically neglected by the public and private sectors.
Undaunted - we believe that bold solutions emerge from the margins (or edges, as we might say). The first answer is usually never right, but we’re not afraid of being wrong. We bring a passionate persistence to breaking through the stalemates and road blocks.
Boundless creativity - we thrive as a team. We take inspiration from “keystone species” in ecology - modeling our work after the resourcefulness of penguins and the vibrancy of bees. We cross-pollinate ideas, sectors, and institutions to help manifest the untapped potential of the people we serve.
Humility in service of community - we care deeply about the communities in which we work, and endeavor to put their needs at the center of how we design and incubate new initiatives. We strive to balance the boldness of our imagination with the recognition that slow, sustained trust building with partners is critical to the long-term viability of the work.
Sheer whimsy - we believe that serious work calls for a playful attitude, as we imagine what is possible. Play is derived from a place of joy and speaks to how we aspire to brighten our days. Plus, what’s life without a lil bit of whimsy?

In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.
